market_summary: Late London session presents broad consolidation across major assets ahead of the New York open. Gold and Bitcoin maintain weak technical postures beneath their session VWAP and Value Area Lows but lack RVOL expansion to justify continuation breakdowns. GBPUSD and US100 are heavily compressed near Point of Control / session baselines with conflicting Cumulative Delta readings. All four symbols are rated HOLD awaiting directional catalyst and liquidity expansion in the NY overlap.

signals.rationale: Price is below VAL (3966.88) and below POC (3978.28), confirming bearish volume profile distribution. CVD is BEARISH (-3.09) aligning with overall downside momentum, though short-term slope is mildly positive (+0.33) reflecting a multi-bar corrective bounce from the session low (3924.30). Market is in LONDON_SESSION approaching NY overlap. Price is firmly below VWAP (3971.22) and EMA50 (3968.19). Price is mid-channel between the lower ATR band (3936.99) and EMA20 (3952.72). RVOL is low at 0.606 with no yellow spike confirming a clean breakdown continuation or reversal. The forming bar is rejecting the EMA20 baseline and printing lower. Given the corrective nature of the bounce and lack of fresh RVOL expansion, HOLD is prudent to await NY open liquidity.
signals.trend_vs_vwap: bearish below downward sloping VWAP and EMA50

signals.rationale: Price is inside the Value Area (VAL 1.32599 to VAH 1.32797) hovering directly at POC (1.32738). CVD is BEARISH (-2,670) with a negative slope (-611.31), diverging from the flat-to-slight upward drift in price. Session is LONDON_SESSION. Price is sitting marginally above VWAP (1.32668) and EMA50 (1.32701), but both lines are flat and compressed within 5 pips. Current position is mid-channel within tight ATR bands (1.32571 - 1.32815). RVOL is low at 0.910 without any volume spike. Trapped between Session High (1.32809) and S/R support (1.32661) with no directional catalyst. Strict HOLD due to range-bound chop inside the value area.

signals.rationale: Price is inside the Value Area (VAL 28086.57 to VAH 28190.28) and above POC (28117.21). Low tick volume (RVOL 0.665, Dukascopy index CFD tick volume caveat applies, but absence of momentum remains evident). Price is trapped between S/R support at 28100.36 and VAH at 28190.28. Conflicting signals and compression ahead of NY session dictate a HOLD.

signals.rationale: Price is below VAL (73377.88) and below POC (73522.35), indicating distribution below value. CVD is BEARISH (-0.04) with negative slope (-0.01), confirming seller control. Session is LONDON_SESSION. Price trades consistently below VWAP (73598.98) and EMA50 (73593.01), both sloping downwards. Signal bar closed as a bearish rejection off EMA20/S/R resistance (73386.80), and the forming bar is pressing down toward support at 73284.60. However, RVOL is below average (0.804) with zero recent yellow spikes, and the lower ATR band (73102.92) and Session Low (73166.00) are very close, creating potential absorption risk without volume expansion. HOLD is warranted until a confirmed high-volume break of session lows occurs.
